# interfere_integration (Data Source)

Look up an existing integration without managing its lifecycle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "interfere_integration" "github" {
  workspace_slug       = "example"
  integration_provider = "github"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `integration_provider` (String) Installed provider, such as github, ghe_cloud, ghe_server, vercel, cloudflare, slack, or cli.
- `workspace_slug` (String)

### Optional

- `integration_id` (String) Select a specific installation when the provider has multiple installations.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
